bestBets.overview: GOLD CHALICE ran very well on debut in Heavy9 conditions on the big track at Geelong. Shot well clear of rivals and stayed closer to the inner than those two out wide who dive bombed him late. He still finished 3.5 lengths in front of fourth. Trick is how the debutants handle heavy with raceday pressure. The attractive looking COME TOGETHER jumped out nicely on Heavy 8 for same raceday rider. Bit keen, but still strong at the finish to win. Easy all the way win in previous jumpout win. Moves well. HYRDO RUSH wasn't overly extended to win jumpout on Heavy 8 at St Arnaud and solid on Heavy 9 here previous one with higher weighted rider than last one. P

raceTips.comment: Gold Chalice ran well on debut, should be better for the experience and with natural improvement prove to be the one to beat. Come Together has shown good ability in jumpouts, while much the same applies to Hydro Rush. Prince Of Portland hit the line quite well first up on the Synthetic.
